hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; [ -f apps/ch-life/package.json ] && cd apps/ch-life; [ -f "$FILE" ] && pnpm eslint --fix "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; [ -f apps/ch-life/package.json ] && cd apps/ch-life; pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
